title: A characteristic-graph reduction for deterministic L-system inference with classical and quantum-heuristic solvers
abstract: arXiv:2411.19906v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: L-systems are widely used to model and simulate biological growth processes, including plant development. Motivated by the broader goal of automating L-system construction, this paper studies the formal deterministic context-free L-system (D0L-system) inference problem in which the input is a finite, noise-free sequence of strings. We introduce the characteristic graph of a string sequence and prove that the existence of a compatible D0L-system is equivalent to the existence of an independent set of a prescribed size in this graph. This gives polynomial reductions from D0L inference to maximum independent set (MIS) and SAT, and hence an exact classical decision route when combined with an exact MIS or SAT solver. We also describe a Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)-based quantum heuristic for generating candidate independent sets. tldr: 本文提出字符串序列的“特征图”概念，证明D0L系统推断问题等价于在该图中寻找指定大小的独立集，从而将推断问题多项式归约到最大独立集与SAT问题，并给出基于QAOA的量子启发式求解方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the characteristic graph of a string sequence and proves that D0L-system inference is equivalent to finding an independent set of a prescribed size, yielding polynomial reductions to MIS and SAT with exact classical solvers, along with a QAOA-based quantum heuristic.
